menu_deck1_1_desc: Learn faster and share your experience with others, old timer.
menu_deck1_1_detailed_desc:
You and your crew gain ##15%## more experience for completing days and jobs.

This multiplier can stack with others who also have the perk equipped.

Your chance of getting a higher quality item during a PAYDAY is increased by ##200%##.
menu_deck2_1_desc: Somehow, you find more value in small loot than others.
menu_deck2_1_detailed_desc: Adds ##20%## more value to loose items that you pick up.
menu_deck3_1_desc: Your drills work better, faster and cast lightning bolt against saboteurs.
menu_deck3_1_detailed_desc:
Enemies that attempt to break your drills have a ##$multiperk## chance of being electrocuted, stopping their sabotage attempt.

Your drill and saw timers are decreased by ##$multiperk3##, they can also automatically restart in ##$multiperk2## seconds after breaking.
menu_deck4_1_desc: Become a skilled negotiator during hostage situations.
menu_deck4_1_detailed_desc:
Trading a hostage for resources will now restore ##$multiperk## health for you and your crew.

You and your crew can now trade for resources regardless of whether you are missing any downs.

You and your crew will gain ##$multiperk2## max health and ##$multiperk3## stamina for each hostage up to ##$multiperk4## times.

Your cable tie supply is increased by ##$multiperk5##.

Note: Crew perks do not stack.
menu_deck5_1_detailed_desc:
All firearms have a chance to spread panic among your enemies.

Panic will make enemies go into short bursts of uncontrollable fear.

You are ##$multiperk## more likely to be targeted when you are close to your crew members.

When wearing armor, your movement speed is ##$multiperk2## less affected.
menu_deck6_1_desc: For you, action isn't the juice.
menu_deck6_1_detailed_desc:
You can now equip a secondary deployable to bring with you.
The quantity of your secondary deployable is not reduced by any means.
Press $BTN_BOTTOM_L; to toggle between deployables.

You deploy and interact with all deployables ##$multiperk## faster.

You receive a ##$multiperk2## damage reduction when standing within ##$multiperk3## of your crewmate or a converted enemy.
menu_deck7_1_desc: An explosive surprise once upon a while.
menu_deck7_1_detailed_desc: You will now find a throwable once ##$multiperk## ammo pickups.
menu_deck8_1_detailed_desc: You can now lockpick doors while in casing mode.
menu_deck9_1_desc: Improve effectiveness of your Smoke Bombs.
menu_deck9_1_detailed_desc:
While inside your smoke screen, you and your crew gain additional ##$multiperk## dodge chance and immunity to armor suppression.

You and your crew will retain the smoke screen's effects for ##$multiperk2## seconds after exiting it.
menu_deck10_1_desc: Restart a drill with melee attacks.
menu_deck10_1_detailed_desc: You can restart a drill by hitting it with a melee attack ##$multiperk## times.
menu_deck11_1_detailed_desc:
Your ballistic vests now grant ##$multiperk## bullet damage reduction to your health and immunity to armor suppression.

Your ballistic vests can no longer be penetrated by armor piercing rounds.
menu_deck12_1_detailed_desc:
Getting ##3## kills in less than 10 seconds increases your chance to dodge by ##$multiperk## for 10 seconds.

Akimbo weapons' stability penalty is ##halved##.
menu_deck13_1_desc: Expertise in maintaining your protective gear.
menu_deck13_1_detailed_desc:
Your armor recovery rate is increased by ##$multiperk##.

When your armor gets depleted you will be immune to health damage for ##$multiperk2## seconds.
This cannot occur more than once every ##$multiperk3## seconds.
menu_deck14_1_detailed_desc: When you pick up ammo, you share ##$multiperk## of the amount you've collected to the other players in your team.
menu_deck15_1_detailed_desc:
Instead of fully regenerating armor when out of combat, you will continuously regenerate chunks of armor over time. Heavier armor regenerates larger amounts, but over longer intervals.

Dealing damage grants you armor. Heavier armor regenerates more, but with longer intervals.

Your total health is reduced by ##$multiperk##.
menu_deck16_1_desc: Sweet, sweet dopamine lessens the pain.
menu_deck16_1_detailed_desc:
##100%## of damage you deal is converted into Hysteria Stacks, up to ##120## every ##0.2## seconds. Max amount of stacks is ##300##.

You gain ##1## damage absorption for every ##20## stacks of Hysteria. You lose ##24## Hysteria Stacks every ##1.2## seconds.

Damaging an enemy will regenerate ##1## health every ##0.3## seconds for ##3## seconds. This effect stacks but cannot occur more than once every ##1.5## seconds.

All of your armor is converted and applied to your health.
menu_deck17_1_detailed_desc:
Your chance to dodge is increased by ##$multiperk## for ballistic vests.

Standing still and crouching increases your armor recovery rate by ##$multiperk2## and reduces your chance to be targeted by ##$multiperk3##.

You gain ##$multiperk3## crouching movement speed.
